context: Two sisters reminisce about their grandfather and his apprentices
purpose: Teach: 墓/姉妹/一旦/住み/弟子/創業/国々/中立

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 桜、来週おじいちゃんのお墓参り、一緒に行かない?
lines.en: Sakura, want to come visit Grandpa's grave with me next week?
lines.style: Warm, inviting adult voice with gentle affection.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うん、行きたい!お母さんと叔母さん、姉妹で行くんでしょ?
lines.en: Yeah, I want to go! You and Mom are going together as sisters, right?
lines.style: Bright, eager teenage voice with curious warmth.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: そうよ。一旦お寺に寄ってから、あの古い工房も見に行こうと思ってるの。
lines.en: That's right. We're stopping by the temple first, then visiting the old workshop too.
lines.style: Calm, slightly nostalgic adult tone with quiet fondness.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 工房って、おじいちゃんが弟子たちと住み込みで働いてた所?
lines.en: The workshop, you mean where Grandpa lived and worked with his apprentices?
lines.style: Curious, engaged teenage tone with genuine interest.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: そう。創業は明治の頃で、もう百年以上続いてるのよ。
lines.en: Yes. It was founded back in the Meiji era, over a hundred years ago now.
lines.style: Proud storytelling voice with warm, measured pacing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: えー、すごい!そんなに昔からあるんだ、知らなかった。
lines.en: Wow, amazing! I had no idea it went back that far.
lines.style: Surprised teenage voice, rising with genuine wonder.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: おじいちゃんの作品はアジアの国々にまで届いてたのよ、本当に誇らしい人だった。
lines.en: Grandpa's works even reached countries across Asia — he was someone to be proud of.
lines.style: Soft-spoken, admiring tone with quiet emotional depth.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 弟子同士が揉めた時も、いつも中立の立場でいたって、お母さんが言ってた。
lines.en: Mom said even when his apprentices argued, he always stayed neutral.
lines.style: Thoughtful teenage voice with quiet respect and admiration.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: そういう人だったの。だから皆に慕われてたんだと思うわ。
lines.en: That's just who he was. That's why everyone loved him so much.
lines.style: Tender, reflective closing tone with gentle, lingering warmth.
